svg.title: Blood knot — how to tie it
svg.desc: Blood knot, in 6 steps. Overlap the two lines by several inches, facing opposite directions. Wrap one tag around the other line five turns, then bring it back through the gap at the centre. Wrap the second tag around the first line five turns in the opposite direction. Pass it back through the same centre gap, from the opposite side. Wet and pull both standing lines steadily until the wraps roll together. Trim both tags.
svg.text: ~90% of line strength · leader to tippet
